verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a training-data feature for connecting external knowledge sources for its AI to consume, plus a native knowledge base for articles and internal runbooks that Support Agents use to deflect questions. However, the evidence never names specific source types or explains how ingestion syncs content. Missing for 10: explicit ingestion of past tickets as knowledge, named help-center/docs/wiki connectors (e.g., Confluence, Notion), evidence of automatic sync without re-authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, the agent ingests my help center, docs, past tickets, and internal wikis as knowledge sources without manual re-authoring

citations.quote: Supercharge all of Pylon's AI features by connecting training data for the AI to consume.
Make them even more powerful by connecting any external sources of knowledge you have!
A dedicated place to host your support content, including question-and-answer style articles, internal runbooks, and more -- all supercharged with AI and tightly integrated with the Pylon platform.
Support Agents can deflect customer questions using content, gather internal context for your team, and take action.
